story_fr: La capsule Orion a accompli avec succès une mission historique autour de la Lune lors d’Artemis II.
story_en: The Orion spacecraft safely carried the crew farther from Earth than ever before during NASA's historic Artemis II mission.
quote: Orion spacecraft safely carried the crew farther from Earth than ever before during NASA's historic Artemis II mission, concluding with a precisely executed re-entry and splashdown.

story_fr: Lockheed Martin a signé plusieurs accords-cadres pluriannuels pour accélérer la production de missiles avancés.
story_en: In the first quarter, we signed several framework agreements to accelerate and scale munitions production, including advanced Patriot Missile, THAAD, and PrSM.
quote: In the first quarter, we signed several framework agreements to accelerate and scale munitions production, including advanced Patriot Missile, THAAD, and PrSM.

story_fr: Le backlog record de 194 milliards de dollars à la fin 2025 reflète une demande sans précédent.
story_en: With a record $194 billion backlog, 2025 marked a year of unprecedented demand for Lockheed Martin capabilities.
quote: With a record $194 billion backlog, 6% year-over-year sales growth, and free cash flow generation above our prior expectation, 2025 marked a year of unprecedented demand for Lockheed Martin capabilities.

story_fr: Lockheed Martin a livré un record de 143 avions F‑35 jusqu’à la fin du troisième trimestre 2025.
story_en: Lockheed Martin has delivered a record 143 F‑35 Lightning II jets through the end of the third quarter.
quote: Lockheed Martin has delivered a record 143 F-35 Lightning II jets through the end of the third quarter.

story_fr: Les flux de trésorerie opérationnels sont tombés à 220 millions de dollars au premier trimestre 2026, contre 1,4 milliard l’an précédent.
story_en: Cash from operations was $220 million in the first quarter of 2026, compared to $1.4 billion in the first quarter of 2025.
quote: Cash from operations was $220 million in the first quarter of 2026, compared to $1.4 billion in the first quarter of 2025.
